ja: • ヤマトの艦載機コスモゼロ。山本仕様機を1/72スケールで忠実に再現。
• 高機動ユニットや各種ミサイルなど多彩な装備が付属。
• 差し替えパーツにより機首や主翼をたたんだ格納状態を再現可能。
• 同スケールの山本玲のパイロットフィギュアが付属。
• 飛行状態を再現できる専用台座が付属。
en: • Yamato's carrier-based aircraft Cosmo Zero. Faithfully reproduces the Yamamoto specification machine in 1/72 scale.
• Comes with a variety of equipment such as high-mobility units and various missiles.
• By using replacement parts, it is possible to reproduce the stored state with the nose and main wings folded.
• A pilot figure of Rei Yamamoto of the same scale is included.
• Comes with a special pedestal that can reproduce flight conditions.
